st_reflets.name: Place des Témoins
st_reflets.alt: A sunny summer garden square in the lakeside park, painted in ink and gouache, under a big shady tree: Monsieur Verbe the mime raises his hand at a witness stand holding up an onion, spins a toy windmill on a little table, crouches beside a cat watching a mouse hole in a stone mound, poses inside an empty gilded picture frame, jumps for joy with a blank smiley placard and tunes an old radio with a tall antenna. The stone archway with its iron gate on the left leads back to the park; the blue arched door, the green arched door in the ivy wall, the red door of the boathouse by the lake and the white picket gate on the right lead on.

doors.label: Rue des Miroirs
doors.hint: Through the green arched door in the ivy wall

doors.label: Passage des Espions
doors.hint: Through the red door of the boathouse

soupcons.name: Ruelle des Soupçons
soupcons.alt: A sunny lakeside lane, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe the mime catches a blue butterfly in his net, leaps back as an orange cat bursts out of a laundry basket, peers through a magnifying glass at a black cat beside a bowl of soup, saws a plank on trestles, swoons on a bench with the back of his hand on his forehead and rings a brass bell on a post while a duck flaps away in surprise. The blue door on the left leads back to the square; the red door of the boathouse on the right leads on to the spies' passage.

doors.label: Passage des Espions
doors.hint: Through the red door of the boathouse

berceaux.name: Allée des Berceaux
berceaux.alt: A sunny garden alley of apple trees, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe the mime rocks a cradle with a teddy bear in it, tickles a grumpy goat with a feather, holds his hand mirror as he lifts the lid of an old chest to find a golden crown, points as a guide at a blank plaque on a wooden signboard, yawns awake in a hammock while a rooster crows and cranks a jack-in-the-box until the clown pops up. The white picket gate on the left leads back to the square; the green gate in the hedge on the right leads on to the street of mirrors.

doors.label: Place des Témoins
doors.hint: Back through the white picket gate

doors.label: Rue des Miroirs
doors.hint: Through the green gate in the hedge

espions.name: Passage des Espions
espions.alt: A sunny lakeside path with a jetty and a rowing boat, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe the mime spies through binoculars from behind a hedge, cups his ear beside a purse on a tree stump, holds a buzzing phone, scowls at a fly at his ear, stands ringed by a gaggle of geese and sows seeds from a basket as sparrows hop after them. The red door of the boathouse on the left leads back to the square.

doors.label: Place des Témoins
doors.hint: Back through the red boathouse door

miroirs.name: Rue des Miroirs
miroirs.alt: A sunny lakeside street with a perfectly still lake mirroring the mountains, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe the mime drapes a flower garland round a parrot's neck, shields his eyes from the dazzling headlights of a little cream car, points as a guide at a blank framed plaque on a stone wall, cups his ear to a poplar's rustling leaves, pulls a face at a bowl of spinach and kneels at the water to see his own reflection. The green garden gate between the stone pillars on the left leads back to the square.

doors.label: Place des Témoins
doors.hint: Back through the green garden gate
